scores.evidence: Both mermaid figures (図1 skill loading, 図2 subagent round trip) are flowchart TD with short Japanese labels that stay readable at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-04.png, pages/mobile-jp-12.png, pages/mobile-jp-13.png). The term tables, code blocks with highlighted frontmatter lines, steps, prompt and checklist all render cleanly with no overflow on mobile or desktop.

metrics.json shows textOnlyScreens empty on both devices and a desktop median of 39 chars per line, inside the 30–40 target. Every screen pairs prose with a table, figure, code, steps or a check, so there are no walls of text and no empty gaps.

The Japanese-only lesson shows no stray untranslated UI strings, and the diagram labels are in Japanese. Contrast is good across callouts, quizzes and code. Controls stay clear of the 56 px top bar and 60 px bottom bar (pages/mobile-jp-10.png, pages/mobile-jp-31.png), and no screen shows personal data.

niceToHave: On pages/mobile-jp-24.png, exam question 1 options 1 and 2 wrap the paths ~/.claude/skills/api-guide/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/api-guide/SKILL.md inside their chips at 'api-'. Both break at the same point, so the paths can still be compared. If the author wants them on one line, shortening the skill name (for example 'api') would keep each chip whole.

On pages/mobile-jp-18.png, the practice heading '演習：自分の手順をスキルにし、調べものを任せる' breaks as 'スキルに / し、' at 390 px. A slightly shorter heading (for example '演習：手順をスキルにし、調べものを任せる') would avoid the break inside 'にし'.

reader: on pages/mobile-jp-06.png, the soft-wrapped continuation of SKILL.md line 12 ('で、') starts at the code column with no visible hanging indent past the list marker. This is readable but differs from the hanging indent the reader is meant to apply.
reader: the full-length mobile-jp.png is cut off at 16000 px (pageHeight 22217); this review used the per-screen PNGs instead. 14 failed /api/ requests were ignored as environment noise.
summary: The screenshots match the lesson under review (lessonHash sha256:f8e6497346002dd9 from metrics.json), and every hard-failure count in metrics.json is zero (overflow, console, mermaid, unknown-block and broken-image). The biggest strength is the steady visual rhythm: each concept comes with a term table or a vertical diagram, a highlighted code example and a check, and all of it stays readable at 390 px. Nothing needs fixing; the only minor polish is the long path chips in exam question 1 and one heading line break on mobile.
